tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Phone app background behind all content.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, gauge tiles, list rows, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: Selected navigation item, secondary buttons, pressed rows.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, dividers, outlined buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface and surface-high (13.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Units, captions, section labels, inactive navigation (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-stale
tokens.usage: A reading older than 3x its poll interval. Always paired with the word 'stale'.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand colour. Links, live indicator, selected state, normal gauge arc, healthy verdict.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills (7:1 dark, 5.9:1 light).

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Healthy verdict card, extended FAB, highlighted tiles.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text on primary-container (9.9:1 dark, 10.8:1 light).

tokens.name: gauge-normal
tokens.usage: Gauge value arc in the normal state.

tokens.name: gauge-warning
tokens.usage: Gauge value arc in the warning state. Graphic only (3.6:1 on light surface); warning text uses 'warning'.

tokens.name: gauge-critical
tokens.usage: Gauge value arc in the critical state. Graphic only; critical text uses 'critical'.

tokens.name: gauge-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled gauge track. Decorative; the value arc and number carry the meaning.

tokens.name: redline-band
tokens.usage: RPM zone from 92% of the vehicle's redline to the end of the scale.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons; warning banner fill in dark theme.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning fill (9.2:1 dark, 5.6:1 light).

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Soft warning card behind 'Service soon' items; text on it is ink or warning.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical text and icons; critical banner fill.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on a critical fill (6.6:1 dark, 6.6:1 light).

tokens.name: critical-container
tokens.usage: Soft critical card behind 'Stop and check' items.

tokens.name: car-ground
tokens.usage: Android Auto surface background (showcase build). Dark = car night mode.

tokens.name: car-surface
tokens.usage: Tiles and buttons on the Android Auto surface.

families.sans: "Archivo", "Noto Sans Sinhala", "Noto Sans Tamil", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: Health verdict on the dashboard and health-check result. One per screen.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles and the vehicle name.

styles.name: num-xl
styles.usage: Main car gauge value. Always tabular figures (font-feature-settings tnum).

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: Phone gauge value, car tile value. Tabular figures.

styles.name: num-md
styles.usage: Values in reading rows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ease off and switch the A/C off.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Units under gauge values, metadata. Never below 12px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between gauge tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone screen gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing; tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Car screen padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and gauge tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero verdict card, bottom sheets, car tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, navigation pill, FAB.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating navigation bar and FAB only. Cards are flat.
